thesis: COLM is up about 29% in 21 days into a risk-off tape (QQQ below 50/200-day, VIX at the 99th percentile), so it is a crowded outlier that can mean-revert hard if defensives rotate or the market de-grosses. Price is 8.9% above the SMA20 with RSI14 near 75 and sits above the analyst mean target, while revenue growth is only about 2% and the earnings jump is margin-driven. The latest push lacks volume confirmation, and short interest above 15% adds squeeze-and-reversal volatility. Reward/risk of about 1.5 only works from a pullback entry, and the stop at 70.45 is far below the current price, so buying now has poor payoff.
